issues.description: Function name mismatch for the DD measurement routine: the Problem Statement and the Solution Repository define and expect a function named 'dd_measure_all', but the Template Repository provides a stub named 'measure_all_dd'. This naming inconsistency (same conceptual operation, different identifier) will cause students to implement or call the wrong function and cause test failures or confusion when mapping the spec to the starter code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API names consistent. Either rename the template stub 'measure_all_dd' to 'dd_measure_all' (updating its signature and any internal references) or add a small wrapper in the template: def dd_measure_all(state, shots): return measure_all_dd(state, shots). Ensure tests and documentation reference the same name.
